clusterforge.title: Plan, apply, observe, and remove a real Kubernetes workload
clusterforge.scope: Actual Terraform 1.16.1 execution of the pinned Kubernetes application module on a disposable local kind cluster. An explicit ServiceAccount was created, nginx:1.27-alpine was loaded locally, the Deployment became available, and an HTTP response was read inside its pod. All Terraform-managed resources were destroyed. No cloud infrastructure, ingress, or production environment was exercised.

cloudivision.title: From a signed HTTP webhook to one persisted BuildRun
cloudivision.scope: Actual loopback-only Cloudivision API connected to a disposable local Kubernetes cluster, using synthetic repository data and a synthetic webhook secret. The capture shows HTTP 401 for an invalid signature, HTTP 201 for a valid push, HTTP 200 for its duplicate, and exactly one persisted BuildRun. No controller, runner Job, image build, registry push, or GitOps deployment was started.

native.title: Native SSH access to a real isolated Docker Engine
native.scope: Native Rust backend integration checks against temporary direct and ProxyJump SSH targets with fresh lab keys and a real isolated Docker Engine 28.3.3. Read-only listing matched two metadata-only containers; stale sessions and in-flight cancellation were checked. The synthetic fault matrix is separate. This terminal replay does not show a connected desktop UI or a running application workload. Owned containers, network, keys, and SSH agent were cleaned.
